heading: Information reporting for persons claiming certain tax benefits

tree.heading: In general
tree.text: The Secretary shall require any person claiming tax benefits—

children.text: under the provisions of sections 34, 40, and 40A, to file a return at the time such person claims such benefits (in such manner as the Secretary may prescribe), and
under the provisions of section 4041(b)(2), 6426, or 6427(e) to file a quarterly return (in such manner as the Secretary may prescribe).

tree.heading: Contents of return
tree.text: Any return filed under this section shall provide such information relating to such benefits and the coordination of such benefits as the Secretary may require to ensure the proper administration and use of such benefits.

tree.heading: Enforcement
tree.text: With respect to any person described in subsection (a) and subject to registration requirements under this title, rules similar to rules of section 4222(c) shall apply with respect to any requirement under this section.

notes.text: Effective DatePub. L. 108–357, title III, § 303(c), Oct. 22, 2004, 118 Stat. 1466, provided that: “The amendments made by this section [enacting this section] shall take effect on January 1, 2005.”
